summary: The word contains at most the 26 distinct lowercase English letters, and the closed-form solution performs fixed arithmetic on its length, so legal inputs cannot support an honest asymptotic runtime scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: word has length from 1 through 26, contains lowercase English letters, and all of its letters are distinct.

replacement_checks.evidence: Eight keys provide eight slots at each push depth; at most four depths are needed for 26 letters, and divmod plus the arithmetic-series formula evaluates their total with fixed work.
Regression checks every legal length from 1 through 26 against an independent sorted keypad-slot cost oracle.
